vocabularies.description: The normalized typed-Haxe value family presented to the representation planner.

values.name: SourceScalar
values.meaning: a primitive scalar with Rust Copy semantics

values.name: SourceEnumValue
values.meaning: a reusable Haxe enum value

values.name: SourceClassReference
values.meaning: a concrete Haxe class reference with stable identity and shared mutation

values.name: SourcePolymorphicReference
values.meaning: an interface or polymorphic class reference represented through a trait object

values.name: SourceBorrowedRef
values.meaning: an immutable rust.Ref borrow token

values.name: SourceBorrowedMutRef
values.meaning: a mutable rust.MutRef borrow token

values.name: SourceBorrowedStr
values.meaning: a borrowed rust.Str view

values.name: SourceBorrowedSlice
values.meaning: an immutable rust.Slice view

values.name: SourceBorrowedMutSlice
values.meaning: a mutable rust.MutSlice view

values.name: SourceNativeOwned
values.meaning: an explicitly Rust-native owned value

values.name: SourceNativeHandle
values.meaning: an explicitly Rust-native resource or RAII handle

values.name: SourceDynamic
values.meaning: a Haxe Dynamic-compatible payload

values.name: SourceString
values.meaning: a Haxe String under the selected nullable or owned contract

values.name: SourceArray
values.meaning: a Haxe Array with shared identity and mutation

values.name: SourceAnonymousObject
values.meaning: a runtime-shaped anonymous Haxe object

values.name: SourceFunctionValue
values.meaning: a reusable Haxe function value

values.name: SourceIterator
values.meaning: the Haxe method-shaped iterator protocol

values.name: SourcePortableFacade
values.meaning: a portable facade with an admitted native Rust representation

values.name: SourceCoreHandle
values.meaning: a compiler-known Class or Enum numeric handle

values.name: SourceBytesReference
values.meaning: a shared haxe.io.Bytes reference

vocabularies.description: Whether observable source semantics require stable reference identity.

values.name: IdentityNone
values.meaning: the value has no observable reference identity

values.name: IdentityStable
values.meaning: aliases must observe the same stable reference identity

vocabularies.description: How mutation is observable through the typed source value.

values.name: MutationImmutable
values.meaning: the source value is immutable

values.name: MutationOwned
values.meaning: mutation belongs to one owned Rust value

values.name: MutationExclusiveBorrow
values.meaning: mutation is admitted only through one lexical mutable borrow

values.name: MutationShared
values.meaning: mutation must remain visible through aliases

vocabularies.description: Whether a value may outlive its immediate lexical region.

values.name: EscapeLocal
values.meaning: the value is confined to its admitted lexical region

values.name: EscapeMay
values.meaning: the value may be returned, stored, captured, or otherwise escape

vocabularies.description: The source-language authority that admits the representation.

values.name: SurfacePortableHaxe
values.meaning: ordinary portable Haxe semantics

values.name: SurfacePortableFacade
values.meaning: an explicitly admitted portable facade

values.name: SurfaceRustNative
values.meaning: an explicit rust.* or typed native surface

vocabularies.description: Whether the typed source value admits null.

values.name: NonNullable
values.meaning: null is outside the source contract

values.name: Nullable
values.meaning: the representation must preserve a null value

vocabularies.description: The contextual boundary at which Rust trait or lifetime requirements apply.

values.name: BoundaryLocal
values.meaning: ordinary single-thread local use

values.name: BoundaryThread
values.meaning: an OS-thread spawn boundary

values.name: BoundaryTask
values.meaning: an asynchronous task spawn boundary

values.name: BoundaryDynamic
values.meaning: boxing into the runtime Dynamic payload

values.name: BoundaryStaticStorage
values.meaning: shared static storage with process lifetime

vocabularies.description: The closed Rust storage shape selected before AST emission.

values.name: RepresentationCopyValue
values.meaning: an ordinary Rust Copy value

values.name: RepresentationOwnedValue
values.meaning: an ordinary owned Rust value

values.name: RepresentationSharedIdentity
values.meaning: a nullable HxRef-style shared identity handle

values.name: RepresentationSharedTraitObject
values.meaning: a shared trait-object identity handle

values.name: RepresentationBorrowedToken
values.meaning: a lexical Rust borrow or borrowed view

values.name: RepresentationNativeHandle
values.meaning: an owned Rust-native resource or RAII handle

values.name: RepresentationDynamicPayload
values.meaning: the hxrt Dynamic carrier

values.name: RepresentationRuntimeString
values.meaning: the nullable Haxe-compatible runtime string carrier

values.name: RepresentationRuntimeArray
values.meaning: the Haxe-compatible shared runtime array carrier

values.name: RepresentationRuntimeAnonymousObject
values.meaning: the shared runtime anonymous-object carrier

values.name: RepresentationSharedFunction
values.meaning: the shared Haxe function-value carrier

values.name: RepresentationRuntimeIterator
values.meaning: the Haxe iterator adapter carrier

vocabularies.description: How the selected Rust representation preserves source-level nullability.

values.name: NullNotAdmitted
values.meaning: the typed source value does not admit null

values.name: NullIntrinsic
values.meaning: the selected carrier owns its null sentinel

values.name: NullOuterOption
values.meaning: lowering wraps the selected base representation in Option

vocabularies.description: The ownership behavior of the selected Rust representation.

values.name: OwnershipCopy
values.meaning: reads copy the value

values.name: OwnershipMove
values.meaning: ordinary Rust moves own the value

values.name: OwnershipShared
values.meaning: a shared handle preserves aliases and identity

values.name: OwnershipBorrowed
values.meaning: the value is a lexical non-owning token

vocabularies.description: How lowering preserves source-level reuse without blanket Clone bounds.

values.name: ReuseCopy
values.meaning: reuse is free because the value is Copy

values.name: ReuseMoveOnce
values.meaning: the value moves and cannot be implicitly reused

values.name: ReuseCloneWhenNeeded
values.meaning: lowering clones only when later source reuse requires it

values.name: ReuseBorrow
values.meaning: reuse remains inside the admitted borrow region

vocabularies.description: The stable reason why a Rust storage shape was selected.

values.name: ReasonHaxeScalar
values.meaning: the Haxe scalar maps directly to a Rust Copy value

values.name: ReasonHaxeEnum
values.meaning: the Haxe enum maps to an owned reusable Rust enum

values.name: ReasonHaxeClassIdentity
values.meaning: class aliases require shared identity and mutation

values.name: ReasonHaxePolymorphicIdentity
values.meaning: interface or subclass dispatch requires a shared trait object

values.name: ReasonRustBorrowSurface
values.meaning: an explicit rust.* borrow surface admits a lexical Rust reference

values.name: ReasonRustOwnedSurface
values.meaning: an explicit rust.* surface admits an owned Rust value

values.name: ReasonRustNativeHandle
values.meaning: an explicit native facade owns a Rust resource or RAII handle

values.name: ReasonHaxeDynamicPayload
values.meaning: Dynamic semantics require the runtime payload carrier

values.name: ReasonHaxeStringContract
values.meaning: the selected Haxe string contract determines owned or runtime storage

values.name: ReasonHaxeArrayContract
values.meaning: Haxe Array aliases require shared runtime storage

values.name: ReasonHaxeAnonymousObject
values.meaning: anonymous-object fields require runtime object storage

values.name: ReasonHaxeFunctionValue
values.meaning: Haxe function values are reusable shared callable handles

values.name: ReasonHaxeIteratorContract
values.meaning: the Haxe iterator protocol uses the runtime iterator adapter

values.name: ReasonAdmittedPortableFacade
values.meaning: a per-surface contract admits the native representation

values.name: ReasonHaxeCoreHandle
values.meaning: Class and Enum values use compiler-known numeric handles

values.name: ReasonHaxeBytesIdentity
values.meaning: haxe.io.Bytes preserves shared identity and mutation

vocabularies.description: The semantic reason a decision requires hxrt rather than ordinary Rust alone.

values.name: RuntimeObjectIdentity
values.meaning: Haxe object identity requires runtime-managed reference semantics

values.name: RuntimeReferenceMutation
values.meaning: shared reference mutation requires runtime-managed storage

values.name: RuntimeDynamic
values.meaning: Dynamic-compatible values require runtime representation

values.name: RuntimeReflection
values.meaning: reflection or runtime introspection requires runtime support

values.name: RuntimeAnonymousObject
values.meaning: anonymous runtime objects require runtime object storage

values.name: RuntimeException
values.meaning: Haxe exception payload semantics require runtime support

values.name: RuntimeNullableCompat
values.meaning: nullable compatibility mode requires runtime-backed null representation

values.name: RuntimeSharedClosureCell
values.meaning: captured shared mutation requires a runtime-managed closure cell

values.name: RuntimePlatformAbstraction
values.meaning: portable platform APIs require a runtime abstraction

values.name: RuntimeHaxeArraySemantics
values.meaning: Haxe Array semantics require runtime array representation

values.name: RuntimeHaxeStringSemantics
values.meaning: Haxe String compatibility requires runtime string representation

values.name: RuntimeFunctionValue
values.meaning: reusable Haxe callable values need a shared runtime carrier

values.name: RuntimeIteratorSemantics
values.meaning: the Haxe iterator adapter needs runtime state

vocabularies.description: The contextual Rust trait or lifetime requirement introduced at a real boundary.

values.name: BoundClone
values.meaning: the boundary needs to duplicate the payload

values.name: BoundSend
values.meaning: ownership may cross a Rust thread or task

values.name: BoundSync
values.meaning: shared access may cross a Rust thread or task

values.name: BoundStatic
values.meaning: the payload must outlive borrowed source regions
